# One Million Predictions

> > Comprehensive football predictions and betting tips covering major leagues (La Liga, Serie A, Premier League), European competitions (Champions League, Europa League, Conference League), and South American tournaments (Copa Sudamericana, Liga MX, Brazil Serie A).

One Million Predictions provides daily match predictions, betting odds, league tables, and fixtures across global football competitions. The site offers specialized predictions for various bet types including 1X2, over/under goals, corners, yellow cards, and correct scores, with premium content available through Patreon membership.
